name: remora-api-bdd
description: API BDD automation for Remora, powered by Playwright and Cucumber

scripts.test: npm run typecheck && npm run prepare:reports && cucumber-js
scripts.test:smoke: npm run typecheck && npm run prepare:reports && cucumber-js --tags @smoke
scripts.test:regression: npm run typecheck && npm run prepare:reports && cucumber-js --tags @regression
scripts.test:uat:report: npm run test:uat && npm run report
scripts.test:dry: cross-env CUCUMBER_REPORTS=false TARGET_ENV=local BASE_URL=https://example.test API_EMAIL=dry-run@example.test API_PASSWORD=dry-run-password TARGET_COMPANY_ID=dry-run-company TARGET_COMPANY_NAME=Dry-Run-Company cucumber-js --dry-run
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run test:unit && npm run test:dry && node scripts/run-mock-suite.cjs
